name: Aniyomi
hook: Watch anime and read manga in one app — extension-based, mpv player, no ads.
bullets: Anime streaming and manga reading in a single app
Built on mpv-android for powerful video playback with customizable settings
Tracker support: MyAnimeList, AniList, Kitsu, Simkl, and more
setupSteps: Download Aniyomi from GitHub or aniyomi.org
Install the APK on your Android device (requires Android 8.0+)
Install anime and manga extensions from within the app
Browse, watch, and read — all in one place
details: Aniyomi is a free and open-source anime player and manga reader for Android, based on Mihon. It combines anime streaming with manga reading in a single app, using an extension-based system for both content sources. The video player is built on mpv-android, offering hardware decoding, gesture controls, and extensive customization. Tracker integration syncs your progress with MyAnimeList, AniList, Kitsu, Simkl, and other services. Features include library categories, scheduled updates, light/dark themes, and local backups. Licensed under Apache-2.0 with 7.6k+ GitHub stars.
setup: Install the Android app, no server needed
